rules.scope: Purchases and contracts governed by a category-specific Threshold
rules.required_action: Use the applicable Procurement Legislation threshold published on the Procurement Intranet page, as amended from time to time.
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Intranet threshold publication and procurement record
rules.verbatim_quote: “Threshold” refers to the relevant financial thresholds relating to Goods & Services, Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts as set out in the applicable Procurement Legislation and published on the Procurement Intranet page, as amended from time to time.

rules.scope: Acquisition of goods, services or works from an external source
rules.required_action: Treat steps leading to commitment of public funds to obtain something externally as procurement.
rules.evidence_source: Procurement, purchase order, contract, quotation or payment records
rules.verbatim_quote: In essence, if you are taking steps that lead to the commitment of public funds to obtain something from outside the organisation, you are procuring.

rules.scope: Formal written or verbal agreements for externally provided goods, services or works
rules.required_action: Treat a formal written or verbal agreement committing the Council to receive external provision for payment or other value as a contract.
rules.evidence_source: Agreement, purchase order, accepted quotation, terms or correspondence
rules.verbatim_quote: You are entering a contract whenever you make a formal agreement—written or verbal—that commits the council to receive goods, services, or works from an external provider in exchange for payment or other value.

rules.scope: Renewal or extension of an existing contract
rules.required_action: Treat renewal or extension of an existing contract as entering a contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: Renewing or extending an existing contract.

rules.scope: Funding or grants provided to an external organisation
rules.required_action: Treat providing funding or a grant to an external organisation as entering a contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: Providing funding or a grant to an external organisation.

rules.scope: Council purchases of works, supplies and services
rules.required_action: Apply the Rules to purchases by or on behalf of the Council.
rules.verbatim_quote: purchases by or on behalf of the Council of works, supplies and services;

rules.scope: Contracts and contractual arrangements entered into by or on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Apply the Rules except where the contract or purchasing method is expressly excluded under Procurement Legislation.
rules.evidence_source: Contract file and documented legislative exclusion
rules.verbatim_quote: all contracts including (but not limited to) purchase orders, consultancy agreements, service level agreements, software licences, concessions and contractual arrangements entered into by or on behalf of the Council, except for contracts and purchasing methods expressly excluded under Procurement Legislation.

rules.scope: Procurement by a governing body of a school controlled by the Council as Local Education Authority
rules.required_action: The Headteacher or a person delegated by them must follow these Rules.
rules.verbatim_quote: If a Governing Body of a school under the control of the Council as Local Education Authority intends to enter into a contract for works, supplies or services, the Headteacher or such persons delegated for the purpose by them must follow these Rules.

rules.scope: Every Council purchase, contract or official order for works, supplies or services
rules.required_action: Make the purchase for implementing Council policies and in accordance with Best Value, Equality, Sustainable Commissioning and the Social Value Policy.
rules.verbatim_quote: Every purchase, contract or official order for works, supplies or services made by the Council shall be for the purpose of implementing the Council’s policies and must be made in accordance with the Council's duties of Best Value, Equality, Sustainable Commissioning and its Social Value Policy.

rules.scope: Service contracts above the Goods & Services Threshold

low.printed: exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services

rules.required_action: Consider how the procurement or contract might improve West Berkshire's economic, social and environmental wellbeing.
rules.evidence_source: Business case, social value assessment or procurement strategy
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, as required by the Public Services (Social Value) Act 2012, and the Council’s Social Value Policy.

rules.scope: All contracts authorised by the Council
rules.required_action: Ensure the contract accords with a decision of the Council.
rules.verbatim_quote: of the Council; or

rules.scope: All contracts authorised by the Executive
rules.required_action: Ensure the contract accords with a decision of the Executive.
rules.verbatim_quote: of the Executive; or

rules.scope: All contracts authorised under the Scheme of Delegation
rules.required_action: Ensure the contract accords with a decision within the Council's Scheme of Delegation.
rules.approver: Authority identified in the Scheme of Delegation
rules.verbatim_quote: within the Council’s Scheme of Delegation by:

rules.scope: Contracts decided under delegated authority by an Executive Decision Maker
rules.required_action: Obtain a decision from an Executive Decision Maker where this delegated route is used.
rules.verbatim_quote: an Executive Decision Maker;

rules.scope: Contracts decided under delegated authority by a Council Committee or Sub-Committee
rules.required_action: Obtain a decision from a Council Committee or Sub-Committee where this delegated route is used.
rules.verbatim_quote: a Council Committee or Sub-Committee; or

rules.scope: Contracts decided under delegated authority by an officer
rules.required_action: Obtain a decision from an officer or their delegate where this delegated route is used.
rules.verbatim_quote: an officer or their delegate for the purpose.

rules.scope: All contracts
rules.required_action: Do not enter a contract unless it accords with existing provision in the Council-approved Budget.
rules.evidence_source: Budget approval and budget availability record
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.scope: Contract awards over £500,000
rules.required_action: Treat the contract award as a Key Decision of the Council.
rules.approver: Authority applicable to a Key Decision
rules.evidence_source: Key Decision and contract award record
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.scope: Contracts where the Service Director lacks delegated authority
rules.required_action: Obtain the approval required by Appendix A before award.
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Service Director does not have delegated authority to enter into a contract, approval in accordance with Appendix A is required before the contract can be awarded.

rules.scope: Expenditure exceeding £500
rules.required_action: Publish the expenditure, including payments to suppliers and contractors.
rules.verbatim_quote: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.scope: Invitations to tender for goods or services contracts exceeding £5,000
rules.required_action: Publish details of every invitation to tender.
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.scope: Contracts in progress and awarded contracts
rules.required_action: Publish a contract register containing key information including value, duration and supplier.
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.scope: Service-area contract information
rules.required_action: Report contract information monthly to the relevant board in the format required by Procurement Legislation.
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.scope: All purchases of supplies, services and works
rules.required_action: Ensure compliance with all relevant statutory requirements.
rules.verbatim_quote: all relevant statutory requirements;

rules.scope: All purchases of supplies, services and works
rules.required_action: Ensure compliance with the relevant Procurement Legislation.
rules.verbatim_quote: the relevant Procurement Legislation;

rules.scope: All purchases of supplies, services and works
rules.required_action: Ensure compliance with the Council Constitution, these Rules, the Financial Rules and the Scheme of Delegation.
rules.verbatim_quote: the Council Constitution including these Rules, the Financial Rules and Scheme of Delegation;

rules.scope: All purchases of supplies, services and works
rules.required_action: Ensure compliance with applicable approved codes, guidance or conditions governing delegated powers.
rules.evidence_source: Procurement compliance record and applicable approved guidance
rules.verbatim_quote: any code, guidance or conditions approved by the Governance Committee and/or the Executive and/or the Council and/or the Health and Wellbeing Board to the exercise of powers delegated by them;

rules.scope: All purchases of supplies, services and works
rules.required_action: Ensure compliance with conditions attached by the Executive or Council to delegated powers.
rules.verbatim_quote: any conditions attached by the Executive or the Council to the exercise of powers delegated by them;

rules.scope: All purchases of supplies, services and works
rules.required_action: Ensure compliance with applicable Legal and Procurement intranet guidance and other Council policies and procedures.
rules.verbatim_quote: the guidance and updates (available from time to time) on the Legal and/or Procurement intranet pages (to include Consultancy Guides) and other policies and procedures of the Council as appropriate.

rules.scope: Conflicts among requirements listed in clause 6.1
rules.required_action: Give Procurement Legislation precedence, followed by the requirements in clause 6.1.6.
rules.evidence_source: Procurement decision record addressing the conflict
rules.verbatim_quote: In the event of conflict between the above, the Procurement Legislation will take precedence, followed by the requirements detailed in 6.1.6 above.

rules.scope: Persons awarded Council contracts for supplies, services or works
rules.required_action: Ensure awarded persons meet the Council's minimum suitability, capability, legal-status and financial-standing standards.
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers undertaking procurement are responsible for ensuring that all persons awarded contracts for the supplies, services or works to the Council meet the Council’s minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.

rules.scope: Contract opportunities advertised by the relevant Service Director
rules.required_action: Advertise electronically on the Council Procurement Portal so the opportunities also appear on the CDP.
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal and CDP publication records
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities being advertised by the relevant Service Director should be done so electronically on the Council’s Procurement Portal to ensure that such opportunities also appear on the Central Digital Platform (CDP) database.

rules.scope: Contract opportunities above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold, except further competitions via a compliant Framework Agreement

low.printed: above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds
above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds
above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds

rules.required_action: Advertise on the CDP before any other advertising medium; a compliant Framework further competition instead invites only framework providers and requires no further advertisement.
rules.evidence_source: CDP publication timestamp, other advertisement records, or framework invitation records
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium (such as a trade journal etc). However, where a Further Competition is undertaken via a compliant Framework Agreement, an invitation will be sent to those providers on the Framework only and no further advertisement will be required.

rules.scope: Contracts of potential cross-border interest
rules.required_action: Publicise the contract so tenderers from other member states can participate and conduct the process fairly and transparently.
rules.verbatim_quote: Where the contract is of potential cross border interest then it must be publicised to ensure that tenderers from other member states have an opportunity to participate and the process is conducted in a fair and transparent manner.

rules.scope: Choice and use of procurement procedure
rules.required_action: Use the correct and appropriate procedure and seek Procurement and Commissioning and Legal advice as necessary.
rules.verbatim_quote: Care must be taken to ensure that the correct and most appropriate procedure is used and advice is sought from the Procurement and Commissioning team and Legal team as necessary on the choice and use of procedures detailed in the Procurement Legislation.

rules.scope: CDP notices
rules.required_action: Obtain approval and issue of the notice by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate.
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or delegate
rules.evidence_source: CDP notice approval and issue record
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate, who will also assist in the conduct of the procurement.

rules.scope: Calculation of Total Contract Value
rules.required_action: Estimate total value over the full potential duration, including extensions, maximum duration and value, options and VAT.
rules.verbatim_quote: Total Contract Value is a genuine estimate of the total value over the full potential duration of the contract, not just the initial term.

rules.scope: Contracts potentially divided to avoid Procurement Legislation or these Rules
rules.required_action: Do not artificially split or disaggregate a contract to avoid applicable provisions.
rules.evidence_source: Aggregated spend, procurement plan and contract records
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.scope: Initially below-Threshold repeat purchases or similar purchases within a specified period
rules.required_action: Seek advice on application of Procurement Legislation when such purchases are envisaged.
rules.evidence_source: Procurement advice record and forward purchase plan
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers responsible for such procurement should therefore seek advice on the application of the Procurement Legislation where they envisage that they may be required to make such purchases.

rules.scope: Contracts with estimated value more than the applicable Threshold
rules.required_action: Issue an electronic Invitation to Tender and require electronic submission via the Council Procurement Portal.
rules.evidence_source: Invitation to Tender and Procurement Portal submission record
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.scope: Electronic tenders
rules.required_action: Specify the electronic submission format and store tenders in a secure portal account locked until the specified opening time.
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal configuration and Invitation to Tender
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers and such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.scope: Tenders received after the specified opening date and time
rules.required_action: Do not accept or consider a late tender unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied exceptional circumstances exist and other tenders have not been opened.
rules.evidence_source: Portal timestamps, tender-opening record and exceptional-circumstances approval
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.scope: Electronic opening of tenders submitted through the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: Have a Procurement Officer conduct the opening and maintain an audit record in the e-tendering system.
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.scope: All quotes and tenders
rules.required_action: Evaluate using criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes or tenders.
rules.evidence_source: Published evaluation criteria and evaluation record
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.scope: Tenders subject to Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Evaluate in accordance with the legislative provisions.
rules.verbatim_quote: Tenders subject to the provisions of the Procurement Legislation shall be evaluated in accordance with the legislative provisions.

rules.scope: All contracts, unless exceptional circumstances are approved in advance
rules.required_action: Award on the most advantageous quote or tender representing best value, having regard to Social Value Policy, rather than lowest price alone.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director for exceptional circumstances
rules.evidence_source: Award evaluation and any advance exceptional-circumstances approval
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.scope: Contracts over £24,999.99 not subject to the relevant Procurement Legislation where urgency delay risks financial loss, personal injury or property damage
rules.required_action: An exception or waiver from competitive purchasing may be used for the stated urgency circumstance, subject to clause 7.4.
rules.evidence_source: Urgency evidence, waiver or exception request and approval
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts which are not subject to the relevant Procurement Legislation Rules, the work, supply or service is required as a matter of urgency and a delay would be likely to lead to financial loss, personal injury or damage to property; or

rules.scope: Contracts over £24,999.99 excepted at lawful management discretion
rules.required_action: Record reasons in writing when the relevant Executive Director or Chief Executive lawfully proceeds in the manner most expedient for efficient Council management, subject to clause 7.4.
rules.approver: Relevant Executive Director and/or Chief Executive, plus authority required by clauses 7.3 and 7.4
rules.evidence_source: Written reasons and waiver or exception approval
rules.verbatim_quote: at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.scope: Waivers or exceptions to the Rules
rules.required_action: Seek a waiver only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances; only the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer may grant it subject to applicable values and delegations.
rules.evidence_source: Advance waiver or exception request and approval
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.scope: Exceptions for contracts up to the applicable Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval for the exception.
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.scope: Exceptions for contracts above the applicable Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: The S.151 Officer must consult the Monitoring Officer and appropriate Executive Director; obtain prior relevant-board approval of an exception report unless urgency prevents it, then supply a retrospective report.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer following consultation and relevant-board approval, subject to urgency
rules.evidence_source: Exception report, consultation record and board approval or retrospective report
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board unless 7.3 applies and for reasons of urgency such prior approval is not possible in which case a report will be supplied retrospectively;

rules.scope: Exceptions for contracts over £500,000
rules.required_action: The S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer must recommend to the Executive after an exception report is prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.
rules.approver: Executive on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer
rules.evidence_source: Exception report, board approvals, recommendation and Executive decision
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.scope: All exceptions or waivers
rules.required_action: Fully document the exception or waiver.
rules.verbatim_quote: be fully documented;

rules.scope: Contracts where Procurement Legislation does not exclude competition
rules.required_action: Submit an advance written exception report to the relevant board that states reasons demonstrating genuine need.
rules.evidence_source: Written exception report and board submission
rules.verbatim_quote: for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director (which shall include reasons for the exception or waiver which demonstrate that the exception or waiver is genuinely required);

rules.scope: All exceptions or waivers
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval and a record that the reasons were considered and circumstances found genuinely exceptional.
rules.evidence_source: S.151 Officer approval and recorded assessment
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional (applications for waivers which are a result of poor contract planning will rarely be considered genuinely exceptional);

rules.scope: All exceptions or waivers
rules.required_action: Seek all relevant approval required under the Rules.
rules.verbatim_quote: have had relevant approval sought under these Rules.

rules.scope: Waivers or exceptions for contracts subject to Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Meet the Procurement Legislation conditions in addition to the Rules' general requirements.
rules.evidence_source: Legal compliance assessment and exception file
rules.verbatim_quote: For contracts subject to the Procurement Legislation, any waiver or an exception from the requirement for competition must meet the conditions set out in the Procurement Legislation in addition to the general requirements above.

rules.scope: Use of a Purchasing Scheme
rules.required_action: Seek advice confirming the Council is legally entitled to use the scheme.
rules.evidence_source: Recorded advice on Purchasing Scheme entitlement
rules.verbatim_quote: the Council is legally entitled to use the Purchasing Scheme;

rules.scope: Use of a Purchasing Scheme
rules.required_action: Seek advice confirming the intended purchases fall within the scheme's coverage.
rules.evidence_source: Recorded advice on Purchasing Scheme coverage
rules.verbatim_quote: the purchases to be made do properly fall within the coverage of the Purchasing Scheme;

rules.scope: Use of a Purchasing Scheme
rules.required_action: Seek advice confirming the scheme complies with applicable Procurement Legislation and Council requirements.
rules.evidence_source: Recorded advice on Purchasing Scheme compliance
rules.verbatim_quote: the establishment and operation of the Purchasing Scheme complies with the Procurement Legislation (where such applies) and meets the Council's own requirements.

rules.scope: Entry into and use of a Purchasing Scheme
rules.required_action: Seek advice from the Commissioning and Procurement Team before entering the arrangement.
rules.verbatim_quote: Advice should be sought from Commissioning and Procurement Team prior to entering to such arrangements.

rules.scope: Each contract above the Threshold, awarded subject to Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: The relevant Service Director must produce the written report required by Procurement Legislation documenting key decisions and steps leading to award.
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation (the Procurement Legislation places an obligation on the Council to document, for each procurement, key decisions and steps taken and stages leading to the award of contracts).

rules.scope: Reports produced under clause 9.1
rules.required_action: Keep the report for three years and make it available if requested by the Cabinet Office.
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.scope: All procurement procedures regardless of value
rules.required_action: Document procurement progress and decision-supporting information and retain it for three years from contract award.
rules.verbatim_quote: In addition to the above, the relevant Service Director should document the progress of all procurement procedures (regardless of value) including ensuring sufficient information is kept to justify decisions such as communications with contractors and internal deliberations, preparation of procurement documents, any dialogue and negotiation, selection and award. Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.scope: All purchases
rules.required_action: Retain written or electronic evidence of the purchase.
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.scope: Contracts detailed in Appendix B
rules.required_action: Put the contract in writing using a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.scope: Contract documents sealed on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Legal Services must retain the documents.
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.scope: Awards of all contracts
rules.required_action: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement or nominee for Contract Register recording.
rules.evidence_source: Formal award notification and Contract Register entry
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.scope: Every contract
rules.required_action: Include the standard clauses in the applicable Standard Form of Agreement issued by the Monitoring Officer or nominee.
rules.evidence_source: Executed contract and applicable Standard Form of Agreement
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement issued and updated from time to time by the Monitoring Officer or their nominated officer and available from Legal Services.

rules.scope: Amendment of a Standard Form of Agreement
rules.required_action: Have the relevant Service Director prepare or amend the form and obtain approval from the Monitoring Officer or delegated officer.
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.scope: Contracts where appropriate
rules.required_action: Include clauses describing the works, supplies, goods, services, materials, matters or things to be supplied or carried out.
rules.verbatim_quote: the works, supplies/goods, services, material, matters or things to be carried out or supplied;

rules.scope: Contracts where appropriate
rules.required_action: Include clauses setting the time for performance.
rules.verbatim_quote: the time within which the contract is to be performed;

rules.scope: Contracts where appropriate
rules.required_action: Include clauses stating required quality requirements or standards.
rules.verbatim_quote: the quality requirements and/or standards that must be met;

rules.scope: Contracts where appropriate
rules.required_action: Include clauses requiring the contractor to hold and maintain appropriate insurance.
rules.verbatim_quote: requirements on the contractor to hold and maintain appropriate insurance;

rules.scope: Contracts where appropriate
rules.required_action: Include clauses setting consequences for whole or partial non-compliance with contractual obligations.
rules.verbatim_quote: the consequences of the contractor failing to comply with contractual obligations in whole or in part;

rules.scope: Contracts where appropriate
rules.required_action: Include clauses requiring contractor compliance with relevant legislation, including equality and health and safety law.
rules.verbatim_quote: requirements on the contractor to comply with all relevant legislation, including (but not limited to) equalities and health and safety legislation;

rules.scope: All contracts involving personal-data clauses
rules.required_action: Include clauses on personal data and complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment to inform them.
rules.evidence_source: Executed contract and Data Protection Impact Assessment
rules.verbatim_quote: clauses regarding personal data and its use by the contractor and/or the Council respectively. Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.scope: Contracts where appropriate
rules.required_action: Include clauses entitling the Council to cancel and recover losses for improper contractor conduct or a Bribery Act offence.
rules.verbatim_quote: the entitlement of the Council to cancel the contract and recover losses in the event that the contractor acted improperly (e.g. seeking to influence the Council to give the contractor any contract) or committed an offence under the Bribery Act 2010.

rules.scope: Council payment obligations in contracts
rules.required_action: Require payment no later than 30 days after the relevant invoice is regarded as valid and undisputed.
rules.verbatim_quote: any payment due from the Council is made no later than 30 days from the date on which the relevant invoice is regarded as valid and undisputed; and

rules.scope: Subcontracts under Council contracts
rules.required_action: Require each subcontract to impose the same payment obligations and pass them into any further subcontract.
rules.verbatim_quote: any subcontract imposes the same obligations upon the subcontractor, and requires that the subcontractor imposes such obligations in any further subcontract.

rules.scope: All contracts
rules.required_action: Include enforceable specifications, briefs or technical requirements addressing effectiveness, quality, sustainability and efficiency as appropriate.
rules.evidence_source: Executed contract and specification or brief
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts shall include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements which are prepared taking into account the need for effectiveness of delivery, quality, sustainability and efficiency (as appropriate) and the need to be able to enforce the delivery of those requirements.

rules.scope: Relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from liability
rules.required_action: Do not allow a relaxation without written authorisation.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S.151 Officer, or their nominated officers
rules.evidence_source: Written authorisation and contract indemnity terms
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.scope: Works contracts, or supplies or services required by stated dates, estimated above £500,000
rules.required_action: The relevant Service Director should consider requiring a performance bond of at least 10% of contract value.
rules.evidence_source: Performance-bond assessment and bond if required
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a contract is estimated to exceed £500,000, in value or amount and is for the execution of works (or for the supplies or services by a particular date or series of dates) the relevant Service Director should consider requiring a performance bond (for an amount equal to at least 10% of the value of the contract) from the contractor (to provide sufficient security for the due performance of the contract).

rules.scope: Required performance bonds
rules.required_action: Use a form approved by Legal Services and include the bond in the Invitation to Tender.
rules.evidence_source: Approved bond form and Invitation to Tender
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.scope: Decision that a performance bond is unnecessary
rules.required_action: Undertake a written risk assessment.
rules.verbatim_quote: undertake a risk assessment in writing; and

rules.scope: Decision that a performance bond is unnecessary
rules.required_action: Seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property.
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and

rules.scope: Decision that a performance bond is unnecessary
rules.required_action: Keep the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.
rules.verbatim_quote: keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.

rules.scope: Contracts whose risk assessment identifies a need for insurance
rules.required_action: In consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominee, set adequate insurance cover levels.
rules.evidence_source: Insurance risk assessment and consultation record
rules.verbatim_quote: in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer set adequate levels of insurance cover (including employer’s liability, public liability and any other as determined by the needs of the particular contract);

rules.scope: Contracts whose risk assessment identifies a need for insurance
rules.required_action: In consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominee, ensure required contractor insurance is held and current or renewed.

rules.scope: Council Common Seal
rules.required_action: Keep the Seal in the Monitoring Officer's custody and in a safe place at their discretion.
rules.verbatim_quote: The Common Seal of the Council (the “Seal”) shall be in the Custody of the Monitoring Officer and kept in a safe place at their discretion.

rules.scope: Documents or proposals to which the Seal is affixed
rules.required_action: Affix the Seal only to a document or proposal approved by the Council, Executive, appropriate Committee, or delegated officer.
rules.approver: Council, Executive, appropriate Committee, or officer with delegated powers
rules.verbatim_quote: The Seal may be affixed, physically or electronically, to any document or proposal that has been approved by a resolution of the Council or Executive, or of an appropriate Committee, or by an officer with delegated powers.

rules.scope: Affixing the Council Seal
rules.required_action: Have the Monitoring Officer or duly designated officer attest and witness the affixing in writing.
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council.

rules.scope: Every sealing of a document
rules.required_action: Make a consecutively numbered entry in the sealing book or electronic record and have the attesting person sign it.
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record to be provided for the purpose and shall be signed (including a digital signature) by the person attesting the sealing.

rules.scope: Petitions to Parliament against a Bill or Provisional Order opposed by the Council
rules.required_action: Affix the Council Seal.
rules.verbatim_quote: a petition to be presented to Parliament against the promotion of any Bill or confirmation of any Provisional Order which the Council opposes;

rules.scope: Mortgages
rules.required_action: Affix the Council Seal.
rules.verbatim_quote: a mortgage;

rules.scope: Incomplete transfers for an authorised Council sale of securities
rules.required_action: Affix the Council Seal.
rules.verbatim_quote: an incomplete form of transfer for the duly authorised sale of securities by the Council as necessary for the purposes of dealing with stocks and shares in accordance with the Stock Transfer Act 1963.

rules.scope: Goods, services, works or concession contracts above the applicable Threshold
rules.required_action: Seal the contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.scope: Documents necessary in legal proceedings on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Have the Monitoring Officer or duly authorised officer sign unless an enactment or Council authority provides otherwise.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or duly authorised officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where any document will be a necessary step in legal proceedings on behalf of the Council it shall, unless any enactment otherwise requires or authorises or the Council shall have given the necessary authority to some other person for the purpose of such proceedings, be signed by the Monitoring Officer or duly authorised officer.

rules.scope: Council documents executed without a legal requirement for sealing
rules.required_action: Have the Monitoring Officer or designated officer sign and keep a register of such documents.
rules.verbatim_quote: Where it becomes necessary to execute any document on behalf of the Council not required by law to be under seal, the Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council shall be deemed to have authority to sign such a document accordingly. A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.scope: Selection and instruction of Counsel
rules.required_action: Only the Monitoring Officer or nominated officer may select and instruct Counsel.
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer) shall have discretion to select and instruct Counsel.

notes.issue: The PDF names category-specific Thresholds but prints no current values; all three declared parameter values therefore remain unresolved nulls.
Clause 6.15 says Total Contract Value includes VAT, while Appendix B labels its value bands exclusive of VAT; both source statements are preserved without choosing a basis.

Exact boundaries are inconsistent: £500,000 is included by 7.4.2 but omitted between Appendix A rows 2 and 3 and between Appendix B rows B2 and C; Appendix A row 4 says £2.5 million or more but its action text says in excess of £2.5 million.
The printed lower bound is more than £24,999.99; it cannot be represented as an integer GBP value, so gbp remains null and the exact penny wording is retained.
The required Call-In and Forward Plan references are printed as unresolved placeholders Part [] and []; the source does not identify the applicable Constitution parts.

Appendix C row E specifies approval below and greater than Threshold but says nothing for a contract value exactly equal to Threshold; its above-Threshold action also calls the variation submission an extension report.
Appendix B leaves contracts valued exactly £1,000 outside row A and contracts valued exactly £25,000 within row B1, while row A ends strictly below £25,000.
The source repeatedly uses strictly above or more-than Threshold wording; it does not state the procedure for a value exactly equal to the applicable Threshold.
